struct Point implements Printer {
  x: Int;
  y: Int;

  func print() String {
    return "Point";
  }
}

interface Printer {
  func print() String;
}

func foo() Int {
  let x: Int = 10;
  let y: [Int] = [1,2,3];

  let p: Point = Point { x: x, y: y[0] };
  let str = p.print();

  return x;
}

func@(A,B) main() {
  let x = foo@[A,B]();
}
---
(source-file
  (struct Point
    (implements Printer)
    (struct-body
      (struct-field x
        (named-type Int))
      (struct-field y
        (named-type Int))
      (func
        (func-sig print
          (params)
          (named-type String))
        (scope "{"
          (return
            (string "Point") ";") "}"))))
  (interface Printer
    (methods
      (method
        (func-sig print
          (params)
          (named-type String)))))
  (func
    (func-sig foo
      (params)
      (named-type Int))
    (scope "{"
      (let x
        (type
          (named-type Int))
        (int 10) ";")
      (let y
        (type
          (list-type
            (named-type Int) "]"))
        (list
          (int 1)
          (int 2)
          (int 3) "]") ";")
      (let p
        (type
          (named-type Point))
        (struct-expr Point
          (field-init x x)
          (field-init y
            (index y
              (int 0) "]")) "}") ";")
      (let str
        (call
          (field p print) ")") ";")
      (return x ";") "}"))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role A)
        (role B)) main
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let x
        (call foo@
          (shared-role-type
            (role A)
            (role B)) ")") ";") "}")))
